title: Mesoporous SiO2–Prussian blue composite for high-efficiency cesium ion removal
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00411J, Paper
Mubarak A. Eldoma, Nasser Zouli, Mohamed Hassan, Salah Eldeen F. Hegazi, Mohamed A. Mahmoud, Ahmed F. F. Abouatiaa, Mohammad S. Alomar, Nada Abdelmageed, Emad A. Elshehy, Mahmoud T. Abdu, Maiada S. Abdelrahman
This research investigates the development of a mesoporous silica–Prussian blue (HOM-SiO2-PB) composite sorbent, synthesized using a one-pot in situ sol–gel lyotropic liquid crystal method.
